scene.title: The Manor Case
scene.instructions: Re-examine the closed case. Explore the manor, examine what you find, and judge which suspect each piece of evidence supports. Keys: a / b / c.

hall.title: Entrance Hall
hall.description: A drafty hall; coats on pegs, a clock that lost interest in time.

objects.label: dusty clock
objects.inspect_text: It stopped at 3:14. Nobody remembers why.

objects.label: calling card
objects.inspect_text: A card left face-down on the hall table.

objects.label: torn invitation
objects.inspect_text: Half an invitation, torn diagonally.

study.title: The Study
study.description: Books stacked spine-inward; a desk that has seen arguments.

objects.label: desk ledger
objects.inspect_text: A ledger lies open at the centre page.

objects.label: hearth ash
objects.inspect_text: Something was burned here, recently.

objects.label: marked portrait
objects.inspect_text: A portrait with a scratched corner.

objects.label: letter rack
objects.inspect_text: Letters sorted by no visible system.

objects.label: wax seal
objects.inspect_text: A seal stamped with an unfamiliar crest.

objects.label: inkwell
objects.inspect_text: Ink still wet around the rim.

library.title: The Library
library.description: Two floors of books and one ladder that complains.

objects.label: wine ledger
objects.inspect_text: A heavy ledger records the cellar stores.

objects.label: atlas margin
objects.inspect_text: Notes crowd the margin of one map.

objects.label: lamp oil
objects.inspect_text: Oil bought in an unusual quantity.

objects.label: reading list
objects.inspect_text: A list in a careful hand.

objects.label: book plate
objects.inspect_text: A bookplate peeled half away.

objects.label: index card
objects.inspect_text: One card misfiled on purpose?

parlour.title: The Parlour
parlour.description: Where the household performed its evenings.

objects.label: tea cup
objects.inspect_text: Two cups, one guest.

objects.label: piano key
objects.inspect_text: One key is freshly chipped.

objects.label: card table
objects.inspect_text: Cards dealt but never played.

objects.label: frost on the window
objects.inspect_text: A patch melted from the inside.

objects.label: coat peg
objects.inspect_text: One coat heavier than it should be.

objects.label: cracked mirror
objects.inspect_text: The crack follows a deliberate line.

cellar.title: The Cellar
cellar.description: Cold, exact, and honest about what the house stores.

objects.label: crate label
objects.inspect_text: A label rewritten twice.

objects.label: barrel mark
objects.inspect_text: Chalk marks count the withdrawals.

objects.label: tool rack
objects.inspect_text: One tool cleaned, the others not.

objects.label: cobweb corner
objects.inspect_text: A web broken in one straight line.

objects.label: stair scuff
objects.inspect_text: Scuffs that match no current shoe.

objects.label: box lid
objects.inspect_text: A lid that no longer sits flush.

narrative.intro: The case was closed in a hurry. You have one evening in the manor to re-examine what remains.

block_briefings.practice: A short warm-up round: examine the first pieces of evidence.
block_briefings.investigation: The re-examination begins in earnest. Trust the record, not the story.

ending_bands.text: The file returns to the shelf, unread.
Some threads hold. The report is amended with care.
The record speaks plainly. The case is reopened.
